headless codex restore 的外层启动预算,由内层【两段顺序 stdio 等待】组合而成:initialize 请求(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS_DEFAULT=15)+ thread/start·resume(THREAD_START_TIMEOUT_SECONDS_DEFAULT=60)+ 余量15 = 90;headless 路径无 unix-socket 等待(那 30s 属交互式 CodexAppServer)。为何 actor_runtime 组合不了:它只有 stop/drain/shutdown 的 timeout 与 SupervisionPolicy 的重启预算,没有请求级 deadline 原语,更没有「把若干请求 deadline 相加成一个启动窗口」的表达;而独立拍一个 20s 外层(< 实测 thread/start 9–43s)正是 5091 codex.restart-restore 真红的根,所以外层必须【由内层组合】而不是自选一个数。

外层启动预算的余量项(见 APP_SERVER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS_DEFAULT):覆盖两段内层等待【之外】的非超时开销 —— 进程 spawn、birth-identity 探测(本身被 _process_birth_identity 的 ps 1.0s 超时钉住)、initialized notify、asyncio 调度;实测量级几秒,15s 为保守 slack。为何 actor_runtime 给不了:同上,无请求级 deadline 原语。

On-demand doctor raw TCP connect bound. It classifies one questioned peer as open, refused, or timeout and starts no lifecycle, retry loop, or background work.

Foreground launcher bound on the launcher-owned session host printing its readiness line when it serves the daemon driver in process (daemon attach and catalog build included), or on the launcher-owned Contract Mock publishing its endpoint/token and answering its health probe. It starts no borrowed daemon lifecycle, retry policy, restart loop, or background supervision; a timeout stops only this invocation's owned child process group.

Foreground source-mode launcher bound on the launcher-owned host child (the Python session host, installed or source; for the daemon driver only its health probe after the ready line, its readiness line itself having the BACKEND_READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS budget) and, for hyprial gui dev, on the Vite dev server child emitting its readiness line; the host must emit its exact driver-ready line and serve /__gui/healthz. Each child gets one readiness observation for the user-visible command, not a daemon/agent start policy, restart loop, or borrowed-process supervisor.

Bounded queue-read interval while consuming the one launch-scoped Contract Mock endpoint/token publication or the one HYPRIAL_GUI_READY record of a host or dev-server child. The owning launch timeout is the only deadline; this is not a retry/backoff policy and does not launch or restart anything.

Reads the one launch-scoped HYPRIAL_GUI_READY line of the Python session host (or, for hyprial gui dev, of the Vite dev server) from this invocation's captured pipe and hands it to the caller's parser, which validates service, mode, driver, loopback origin and launch-required session. The function owns only the one deadline; there is no retry, restart, quarantine, borrowed-daemon supervision, or background work.

Scanner false-positive classification: 'start' names arming a timer, not starting a lifecycle. BoundedHttpProtocol._start_timer arms the per-connection read-idle (10 s, refreshed by received bytes) and whole-request (15 s from the first byte) deadlines of the GUI session host's HTTP stack, and closes only that one browser connection when it fires, deferring while an earlier response is still in flight. It starts, restarts, retries or supervises no process or actor and has no backoff; the host is a single child process owned by the launcher. Source audit 2026-11-15: ActorRuntime/EffectLane/GenerationScheduler model daemon actors and effects, not an HTTP connection's receive deadline inside the uvicorn protocol callbacks; the timers are asyncio loop.call_later handles that connection_lost cancels. Pinned by tests/shell/gui/host/relay/test_http_protocol.py.

Upper bound (1s) for the single post-start readiness/error observation after lifecycle.start. It is not a retry, restart, backoff or quarantine policy; the caller waits once for the already-recorded outcome and returns readiness=unconfirmed when neither settles.
